name: Nigerian Fulfulde
notes: Nigerian Fulfulde, the Fula (ff) variety of Northern Nigeria, spoken by ~17 million people (2020 estimate) and following the Pan-Nigerian Latin alphabet standard for its Latin orthography. Inherits the shared Fula grapheme/allophone inventory from ff.json (graphemes_base/allophones_base): no source consulted documents a phonemic or orthographic divergence specific to Nigerian Fulfulde beyond the general vowel-harmony and stop/fricative/nasal pattern already described for ff. Shows 80-90% mutual intelligibility with Adamawa Fulfulde and is most similar to Central-Eastern Niger Fulfulde. Also written in a standardized Ajami (Arabic-based) orthography adopted since 2003 with adaptations for Fulfulde-specific phonemes, not covered by this spec (Latin-orthography scope only, matching the parent ff spec). Quality:research reflects that the child spec's own orthographic claims are not independently sourced beyond straight ff inheritance.
